title: XRP treasury firm Evernorth says SEC registration now effective, clearing way for Nasdaq listing
summary: The S-4 registration statement is for Evernorth's merger with SPAC firm Armada, through which it seeks a Nasdaq listing.

title: Stablecoin reserves fall to $64B – Binance captures 68.5% of exchange liquidity
summary: Stablecoin liquidity is concentrating on Binance, even as much of the market’s available capital shifts away from centralized exchanges.
content: Total stablecoin reserves have declined to 64 billion dollars. Despite this overall contraction in available market capital as funds shift away from centralized platforms, exchange liquidity is increasingly concentrating on Binance. The cryptocurrency platform currently commands 68.5 percent of this specific market share.
